mechanism: Tetrabenazine depletes monoamines (dopamine, serotonin, norepinephrine) while nalmefene is an opioid antagonist; combined use may potentiate CNS depression and increase risk of adverse neuropsychiatric effects including depression and suicidality.
action: Use combination cautiously with close psychiatric monitoring; consider alternative to nalmefene if possible, as tetrabenazine already carries black box warnings for depression and suicidality.
